'''Dhislugs''' were predatory [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropods]] native to [[Algara II]] that relied on externally-excreted [[Acid/Legends|acid]] to digest prey, as they lacked [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. They had two antennae and grew over three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long.
